newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian aluminium down on local price cut fears.
newsitem.headline: Indian aluminium down on local price cut fears.

text.p: Indian aluminium prices and lead fell while other metals were unchanged on Monday, dealers said.
Ready aluminium fell by 50 rupees to 7,350 rupees on expectation that leading local producers may cut selling prices.
It was down by 50 rupees per quintal on Saturday.

"Aluminium prices in the world market have fallen considerably and local producers are now forced to slash prices," one trader said. Lead fell by 25 rupees to 4,925 rupees. Copper was unchanged at 11,650 rupees. Nickel remained steady at 37,700 rupees, tin at 35,600 rupees and zinc at 6,200 rupees on nominal trade.
